name: LMV321
description: Single rail-to-rail input/output op-amp in SOT-23-5, low-voltage single-supply operation (2.7V-5.5V). Part of the same TI family document as the LMV358 (dual) and LMV324 (quad). Modern, small-package successor to older single-supply parts like the LM358; used on the Bus Pirate 5 (also GS321A, a Gainsil second-source with the same pinout).

SOT-23-5.notes: Per TI's own pin table for the DBV/DCK 5-pin SOT-23/SC-70 package.

extra.Vos: 1.7mV typ (7mV max) @ Ta=25C, Vcc=2.7V or 5V (9mV max over -40 to 125C)
extra.Ibias: 15nA typ (250nA max) @ Ta=25C, Vcc=5V (500nA max over -40 to 125C)
extra.Iout: 40mA typ short-circuit current, sourcing and sinking @ Ta=25C
extra.slew rate: not separately specified; see unity-gain bandwidth and phase margin (60deg typ) instead

typical_application: General-purpose single-supply signal conditioning where board space and low quiescent current matter; buffers, comparators-as-amplifiers, and low-power analog front ends.
gotchas: single-supply part; GND (pin 2) is the negative rail, not necessarily earth ground
rail-to-rail input/output, but check the datasheet's actual VOH/VOL vs load before assuming true rail-to-rail swing under heavy load
GS321A (Gainsil) is a second-source with the same pinout and similar specs, not an identical die to TI's part; match numbers to whichever is actually on hand
